# Coursera DL

> High-performance cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri v2, Rust, and React to archive enrolled Coursera courses, HD videos, lecture slides, and multilingual subtitles for offline personal study.

Coursera DL is a free and open-source desktop tool designed for personal backup and offline learning preservation.

## Docs

- [Overview and User Guide](https://courseradl.github.io/): Complete feature breakdown, security and privacy details, interactive flow, and downloads.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/courseradl/coursera-dl-gui): Source code, issues, release binaries, and contribution guidelines.
- [Full LLM Details](https://courseradl.github.io/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive extended documentation and technical architecture for LLMs.

## Optional

- [Latest Releases](https://github.com/courseradl/coursera-dl-gui/releases/latest): Native installers for macOS (.dmg), Windows (.exe), and Linux (.AppImage / .deb).
